title: Grateful Dead Live at Building A, Cal Expo on 1969-11-21
lineage: Transfer: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > USB > WaveLab > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality 1969 tape with a standout High Time and rocking Lovelight, plus a solid second set despite a weak first half.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a decent‑sounding 1969 source—likely an audience tape—with enough clarity to hear Pigpen’s prominent Fender keyboards on “High Time” and the energetic “Lovelight.” Reviewers rave about the second set (China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, Me & My Uncle tease) while noting the first set is less compelling and that a few cuts are imperfect.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 3‑5 stars, praising key songs and the second‑set energy while noting recording quirks and a weak first set; overall this yields a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape from 1969 shows decent clarity for the era, though some cuts are imperfect and there are occasional track‑gap issues.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered weak by listeners; second set shines with strong transitions and memorable moments.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's Fender keyboards are prominent and groovy on “High Time.”
